sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Columns split from a recording comment (Event-Type, Event-City, …): the recording style guide's form without a colon, "live, Los Angeles, CA, USA" (https://musicbrainz.org/doc/Style/Recording#Live_recordings), is now split into Event-City, Event-State and Event-Country (and Event-Venue for "live, Venue, City, State, Country") like a location after a colon. Before, "Los Angeles" landed in Event-Detail and the location columns stayed empty. Two or more parts after the type with no date first count as a location; a single part such as "live, early show" stays in Event-Detail. Without a colon, a "; …" ending now goes to Event-Additional-Info instead of sticking to the country, and "live; intro" is read as type "live" with additional info "intro".
